description: Mount the container root filesystem as read-only, forcing all writable data into explicitly declared volumes or tmpfs mounts. Prevents attackers who achieve code execution inside a container from modifying binaries, planting webshells, or persisting backdoors on the filesystem. Combined with NoNewPrivileges (CME-707) and Dropped Capabilities (CME-705), eliminates post-exploitation persistence mechanisms within the container layer.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: Runtime filesystem modification is blocked; attacker cannot persist malicious artifacts, modify binaries, or plant webshells on the root filesystem

Root filesystem modification is blocked; exploitation chain requires identifying a writable volume mount (tmpfs, emptyDir, PVC) to stage payloads — complexity increase is strongest when writable mounts are minimized to essential paths only

verification.method: Verify container root filesystem is mounted read-only

commands.command: kubectl get pod <pod> -o jsonpath='{range .spec.containers[*]}{"ro="}{.securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem}{"\n"}{end}' 2>/dev/null | grep 'ro=' | grep -c -v 'ro=true'

kubectl get pod <pod> -o jsonpath='{range .spec.containers[*].volumeMounts[*]}{.mountPath}{"\t"}{.readOnly}{"\n"}{end}' 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'true$' | grep -c -E '^/(usr|bin|sbin|lib|etc|opt|srv|var/www)'
